Role Purpose

Execute and monitor day-to-day FWA field-sales activity across assigned territories, improving sales-force productivity and completion of valid customer activations.

Scope of Work

• Daily Field Planning — Assign territories and activity plans to team leaders and AEs based on approved targets.
• Field Coaching — Conduct joint visits, coaching and daily briefings to improve prospecting and conversion.
• Lead & Sales Tracking — Monitor lead registration, order quality, follow-up and progress to activation.
• Team Fulfillment — Track AE staffing, attendance and productivity; coordinate gaps with capability and agency teams.
• Local Access — Support local permits and relationship-building with area stakeholders.
• Issue Escalation — Flag device, installation, app or order blockers to accountable operations teams.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Field sales operations or team supervision experience; requirements scaled to appointed staff/officer level.
• Field execution; customer interaction; mobile sales applications; operational reporting. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.
• Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.

wo-jpfa-JR2757.d:
Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Procurement Administration Staff to support the procurement team at PT Japfa Food Indonesia. This role involves assisting with the administrative aspects of the purchasing process, ensuring efficient operations and accurate record-keeping.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Process purchase requisitions and purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.
* Maintain and update vendor information, ensuring all data is current and complete.
* Communicate with suppliers to follow up on order status, delivery schedules, and resolve minor discrepancies.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing procurement documents, including contracts, invoices, and shipping documents.
* Organize and maintain procurement files, both physical and digital, ensuring easy retrieval and compliance.
* Support the procurement team in data entry, report generation, and analysis as required.
* Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., finance, warehouse) to ensure smooth procurement operations.
* Assist in identifying and resolving administrative issues related to the procurement process.
* Perform other administrative duties as assigned by the procurement manager.

Job Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a Diploma (D3) in Administration, Business Management, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-2 years) in an administrative role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) is essential.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with a strong attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, in Bahasa Indonesia and English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Proactive attitude with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with procurement software or ERP systems is a plus.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
